title: Cylindrical object
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, create a new face and within this face, draw a single loop. Inside this loop, draw a circle centered at coordinates (0.0312, 0.0312) with a radius of 0.0312 units. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0625 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Rotate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to create a solid body. The resulting cylindrical object will have a length of 0.0625 units, a width of 0.0625 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the circular base
circle_center = (0.0312, 0.0312)
circle_radius = 0.0312
workplane = workplane.center(*circle_center).circle(circle_radius)

# Extrude the circle to create the cylinder
extrude_depth = 0.75
workplane = workplane.extrude(extrude_depth)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = workplane

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial coordinate system
workplane = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Create the sketch for the base of the cylinder
sketch = (
    workplane
    .center(0.0312, 0.0312)  # Move to the center of the circle
    .circle(0.0312)  # Draw a circle with the specified radius
)

# Extrude the sketch to create the cylinder
cylinder = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = cylinder
